input: Source ethically made furniture for the nursery

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing which specific furniture pieces are needed (crib, dresser, rocking chair, etc.) determines the scale and complexity of the sourcing task entirely.
Whether this is for a first baby, a second child sharing a room, or another situation affects sizing, quantity, and urgency of purchases.
The total budget directly limits which ethical brands and materials are realistic options, since ethical furniture spans a very wide price range.

The user's definition of 'ethically made' could emphasise very different things — fair labour, sustainable materials, non-toxic finishes, local production, certifications — which changes which suppliers qualify.
The timeline (e.g. due date) creates urgency and affects whether slow-shipping or made-to-order items are viable options.
Whether the user wants to shop online, visit physical stores, or use a mix affects which sourcing channels and brands to prioritise.
Understanding what 'done well' looks like — a shortlist of vetted options, actual purchases made, or a fully furnished room — defines when and how the task is complete.

gold.taskTitle: Source ethical furniture for the nursery
gold.taskDescription: Find and purchase ethically made furniture pieces for a nursery room.

questions.title: Which specific furniture pieces do you need for the nursery?
questions.description: Identify the exact items required, such as a crib, dresser, wardrobe, changing table, nursing chair, or bookshelf.

questions.title: What is your total budget for the nursery furniture?
questions.description: Establish a realistic budget ceiling so sourcing can be focused on ethical brands within the right price tier.

questions.title: What does 'ethically made' mean most to you?
questions.description: Clarify the user's priority — fair labour practices, sustainable or FSC-certified wood, non-toxic finishes, locally made, or specific certifications like GREENGUARD.

questions.title: When does the nursery need to be ready by?
questions.description: Determine the deadline or due date to understand urgency and whether made-to-order or longer lead-time items are an option.

questions.title: Is this for a newborn, or a child of a specific age?
questions.description: Understand who the nursery is for so that appropriate sizing, safety standards, and longevity of the furniture can be factored in.

questions.title: Do you prefer shopping online, in-store, or both?
questions.description: Establish the preferred shopping channel to focus recommendations on the most relevant retailers, marketplaces, or local artisans.

questions.title: What does success look like at the end of this task?
questions.description: Clarify the desired outcome — a shortlist of vetted brands, a full sourcing plan, or confirmed purchases — so the right level of effort is applied.
